title: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS returns only the existing combinations of columns of the same table

source.quote: Each groupBy_columnName column is cross-joined (different tables) or auto-existed (same table) with the subsequent specified columns.
source.supports: columns of one table are auto-existed: only combinations present in the table

derivation: Product rows: Bike Red Vehicles, Helmet Red Accessories, Lock Blue Accessories, Scooter Green Vehicles. Four combinations exist; a cross join would give 3 * 2 = 6 (adding Blue Vehicles and Green Accessories).
